The homepage nav contains no shop/department links at all -- only those same informational pages plus outbound links to sibling TJX banners (tjmaxx.tjx.com, marshalls.com, us.homesense.com, sierra.com). The site's own FAQ states the position explicitly: 'Because each store receives thousands of new items each week, it is impossible for us to produce a catalog that could keep up with all our fabulous new styles' and 'we do not provide a service of tracking merchandise.' The /world-traveler editorial page likewise says '*Collection and styles vary by store, please contact your local store for details.' HomeGoods discontinued online shopping in Oct 2023; inventory is in-store only and rotating, so no sub-category has a stable URL or a published product count. Per the brief this is a legitimate empty result rather than a fabricated tree. NAME/DOMAIN DISCREPANCY: the roster company name is 'Tjmaxx' but the assigned domain is homegoods.com -- these are two different TJX banners. company and brand_site are kept exactly as assigned. The T.J.Maxx e-commerce storefront (tjmaxx.tjx.com) is a separate, genuinely shoppable site and was NOT extracted, since the assignment directs extraction from the assigned domain; if the intent was the T.J.Maxx catalogue, this row needs re-running against tjmaxx.tjx.com.
